BiblicalUsage: Kinesis is a stirring, the moving of the water. John 5:3 pictures the multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water at Bethesda. The word stands only here, in the Received Text's account of the pool.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the waiting is the picture: a crowd of sick people hoping the water will stir, and the Healer standing among them unrecognized.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
